summary: Independently verified the prm-09 public.-qualification fix (ISS-0707 / GH-792) on branch feature/WF03-GH792-20260816, base b8fa5672, head c930c51c. All acceptance criteria PASS. (a) STATIC qualification check (authoritative, since the warm DB masks the 42703): every solution_pack_installs / solution_pack_artefact_bases DML/SELECT reference in tests/integration/prm-09-pack-update.test.zig (L98/L119/L128/L164) and src/definition/pack_update.zig (L120/L182) carries the public. prefix; process_definitions stays unqualified (test L145/L160, pack_update L238). (b) BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm09 (direct, NOT the stale-5433 wrapper) exits 0; direct binary run confirmed 4/4 (TC-PRM-09-01..04 OK). (c) python tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0 (2973 handoffs, 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 pre-existing MINOR, 332 ACK). (d) change confined to the two files — git diff --name-only b8fa5672..HEAD shows no migrations/, no sol02/sol03 files; remaining diffs are workflow artefacts only. (e) zig build test-env-verify exit 0 (10/10 HEALTHY). (f) zig build exit 0. Pre-existing warm-DB SOL-02/SOL-03 legacy-state failure documented as expected and not caused by this fix: observed directly — sol03 (TC-SOL03-01/02) and sol02 (TC-SOL02-01..04) fail with sqlstate 42703 on SELECT id::text FROM solution_pack_installs WHERE pack_id=$1 AND pack_version=$2 at src/solution/store.zig installPack, because tenant_default.solution_pack_installs carries the legacy 1157 layout (verified via pg_catalog; no pack_version/schema_version). store.zig + sol02/sol03 files untouched by this fix; sol02/sol03 do not import pack_update. Structured verification report written to tests/reports/report-20260816-WF03-GH792-20260816.yaml.
